description:
WHAT ARE WE DOING: 
Playing Skyrim with 2000 Hardcore Mods making the game near impossible! The world will also end in 100 days and everytime I die that day counts down by 1. I have to beat this impossible skyrim challenge asap so of course I am going to try and make use of as many gameplay features, glitches and exploits as possible! 

SEO Nonsense
Welcome back to skyrim! Where today we set out on a second attempt of an impossible challenge! Can you beat the survive 100 days in skyrim hardcore challenge? The rules are simple, Legendary difficulty skyrim with survival modes. This is the hardest possible challenge skyrim can offer. You are effectively playing at 1 hp and almost anything will kill you and fail the run. Ontop of that in survival mode you must eat and sleep similarly to an indie survival game.
